### The effect of the distance

It seems as if the distance between the boxes has a qualitative effect on the dynamics only after DEL>1e-6. Thus for now, I will choose DEL=1e-8 as the distance between the boxes. And later investigate the effect on the dynamics of the distance between the boxes again.
